TTS user guide
Read guide
Installation, services, voice packs, encyclopedia selection, language, tone and troubleshooting. Reading does not start a service or change settings.
Choose a chapter. This guide does not start synthesis or change settings.
1. Install and start

Install this optional add-on inside Modules/AnimusForge: AF-GPTSOVITS-L/runtime.json and VoicePacks must be directly below the AF module. Do not create AnimusForge/AnimusForge. It requires an AF build with managed TTS support; copying a folder cannot upgrade an older AF. Select AF-GPTSOVITS and enable speech. AF verifies the package and starts it in the background; a valid L is preferred over U. Wait until ready, then play a test. Cold-start dialogue is not replayed later. Closing speech releases only the service started by AF.
2. Choose a service

AF-GPTSOVITS: automatic local package, no URL or separate Python setup. GPT-SoVITS (manual API): start your own service, then set its URL and optional manifest path. The reference WAV must be accessible to that server; a remote server cannot read your local drive path. Volcengine: configure its own credentials and voice, and enable the dedicated service. OpenAI-compatible: configure the speech endpoint, its own key, model and voice. Streaming depends on the server. Cloud usage may be charged. Switching providers preserves settings; failures do not silently switch to paid services.
3. Voice folders and characters

Local voices live in VoicePacks/Male/<pack>/, Female/<pack>/ or Custom/<pack>/. Each pack needs manifest.json. Only one package-directory level is discovered. Male/Female feed the same-gender random defaults; Custom is manual-only, even if a gender is recorded. Use the hero encyclopedia voice button before or after talking. Named characters keep their saved voice; ordinary soldiers/civilians are not permanent named bindings. Custom voices can be selected deliberately across genders. Stable IDs survive folder renames; changing/removing an ID can require reselection. Cloud voice mapping is separate.
4. Custom recording requirements

Use recordings you are allowed to use and redistribute. Recommended: one speaker, clean mono PCM16 WAV, about 3-10 seconds, clear speech, no music or overlapping voices; 16 kHz is a suitable reference input. Each reference must be nonempty and at most 8 MiB. The transcript must match the recording verbatim; prompt_lang describes that recording (zh/en/ja/yue for L), not the desired output. Record each tone with the same speaker. After editing audio, update its SHA-256. A reference-only voice pack needs no model weights. Dropping arbitrary .pth/.ckpt files here does not load a new character model.
5. Custom manifest requirements

manifest.json contains profiles. Each profile requires: unique id (1-128 characters, no outer spaces), label, speaker_metadata.gender (male/female), category (male/female/custom), reference_file (relative, inside this package), reference_sha256 (64-digit SHA-256), prompt_lang and accurate prompt_text (1-1000 characters). category must match its folder; use custom in Custom. Optional emotion_variants keys: neutral/happy/angry/sad; each supplies reference_file, reference_sha256, prompt_lang, prompt_text. Missing tones reuse the base reference. English labels + permanent codes such as AF-C100 are recommended. Avoid duplicate IDs. Per manifest: at most 2 MiB; discovery: 128 manifests / 8 MiB metadata / 512 voices.
6. Language and emotional tone

Speech output language is shared by all four providers: blank/auto follows the reply; Chinese, Cantonese, English or Japanese (including Chinese names) requests that language. Existing postprocessing keeps matching text or privately translates it; subtitles and history stay unchanged. Missing/invalid translation stays text-only. The remote model/voice must support the chosen language. Local tone comes from accepted postprocess MOOD: JOY/DELIGHTED -> happy, ANNOYED -> angry, otherwise neutral. Sad is available for audition. One voice ID contains all tones; missing variants fall back to its base. Tone references improve control but cannot guarantee acting quality. Local tone metadata is not sent to cloud providers.
7. Playback and VRAM budget

L/U and manual local GPT-SoVITS synthesize only the primary scene interlocutor. Bystanders retain text; private dialogue keeps its target. Peaceful meetings are allowed; real battles block local synthesis. Local speech uses accepted complete replies, then queues sentences; it is not character-by-character live reading of unchecked LLM text. L targets roughly 2 GiB VRAM; this is NOT a hard GPU cap or proof that every 8 GiB card can run it beside the game. Game settings, other apps, drivers, first-use peaks and long lines matter. Disk size, system RAM and VRAM are different. If memory is tight, disable local speech or choose a configured remote service yourself.
8. Refresh, errors and safe updates

After adding a managed voice pack, click Refresh local runtime status; reopening the game also reloads the catalog. For manual API with an explicit manifest, restart AF after editing it. Then select the voice in the encyclopedia and audition it. No sound: check the speech switch, selected service, runtime ready state, voice ID, language/postprocess result and local battle/primary-target restrictions. Missing files, wrong SHA-256, duplicate IDs and unsupported languages fail safely. Inspect Logs/TTS; cache is under Cache/TTS. Do not publish keys/tokens/private dialogue. Install only trusted packages. L add-ons must not replace AF DLLs, SubModule.xml or other gameplay files. Existing character recordings are local evaluation assets, not automatically cleared for public redistribution.
AF-GPTSOVITS-L tutorial. Reading does not download, start a model, or change settings.
L guide 1 - Download and version

Download: AF-GPTSOVITS-L_0.1.0.zip Baidu Netdisk: https://pan.baidu.com/s/1Wsl1hXm5Mz2_7DRetX94FA?pwd=5qkj Extraction code: 5qkj This is an optional lightweight voice add-on for AF, not the main AF mod or the upstream training distribution. An AF build with AF-GPTSOVITS support is required. The local same-version test archive is about 5GB compressed / 7.3GiB extracted. Allow about 15GB for download, extraction and cache; check the actual shared file size. A future U edition needs its own download and guide; L memory figures do not apply to U.
L guide 2 - Installation

1. Close the game and launcher; extract to a temporary folder first. 2. Put AF-GPTSOVITS-L and VoicePacks inside the existing Modules/AnimusForge folder. If the archive has an AnimusForge wrapper, merge its contents rather than nesting AnimusForge twice. 3. Check Modules/AnimusForge/AF-GPTSOVITS-L/runtime.json and Modules/AnimusForge/VoicePacks. Keep server.py, lite_engine.py, app and runtime intact. 4. The add-on must not replace AF bin, SubModule.xml, ModuleData or gameplay files. Preserve custom voices and existing manifests; never delete the whole AF module. 5. No separate Python installation or old port-9880 server is needed; AF owns its managed process.
L guide 3 - Enable and assign voices

In MCM TTS API / speech settings, select AF-GPTSOVITS-L / U (auto) and enable speech. AF detects a compatible package and prefers L when both are present. Wait for Ready, then test local speech. Cold starts can take tens of seconds to a minute or two; do not repeatedly refresh. Choose a voice in the character encyclopedia even before the first conversation. Named characters retain their random selection. Male/Female are same-gender default pools; Custom is manual-only. Local L/U speech reads only the primary interlocutor; bystanders keep text. Private dialogue uses its current target. Peaceful meetings are allowed; real combat blocks local synthesis. Accepted complete replies are read sentence by sentence, not unchecked token-by-token. After adding voices, refresh local runtime status or restart. Disabling speech releases only the service AF started.
L guide 4 - VRAM and performance

A compatible NVIDIA GPU with 8GB VRAM is a practical starting point for testing; 12GB/16GB leaves more room beside the game. This is not a guarantee or a reason to buy a GPU solely for this add-on. Cards with 6GB or less are not recommended for concurrent gaming; consider a manually selected remote TTS service. This portable build targets Windows/CUDA; AMD, Intel and CPU-only plug-and-play operation is not validated. L targets roughly 2GiB VRAM, NOT a hard cap. On a 16GB RTX 5070 Ti, 17 real syntheses sampled every 100ms peaked around 1546MiB (1.51GiB) of process dedicated VRAM. This is not an 8GB-card/game coexistence test and may miss short spikes. On 8GB cards, leave roughly 2–3GB headroom for speech, lower game texture/graphics settings and close other GPU apps. An audition is not a long-session stability test. Watch total dedicated VRAM, stalls and long lines; disable local speech or select remote TTS if needed. VRAM, system RAM and disk space are separate budgets.
L guide 5 - Custom recordings

A reference voice pack is not a trained model: it uses recordings, exact transcripts and manifest.json. Arbitrary .pth/.ckpt files are not plug-and-play character packs. Recommended: one speaker, clean mono PCM16 WAV, about 3–10 seconds per reference; 16kHz is a suitable input. Do not upsample merely to claim quality. Avoid music, other voices, clipping, reverb or silence-only clips. Each file must be nonempty and no larger than 8MiB. prompt_text must match that exact recording (1–1000 characters); prompt_lang describes the reference audio, not the requested speech language. This L build recommends zh/en/ja/yue. Use the same character for every emotional reference. Recalculate SHA-256 after editing WAV files and update the manifest. Use voices you have permission to use; public distribution also needs rights to the recordings/character assets. An open-source code license does not license voice recordings.
L guide 6 - Folders and manifest

Example: VoicePacks/Custom/MyVoice-AF-C100/manifest.json, with reference.wav beside it and tones/angry.wav below it. Discovery scans one package-folder level under Male/Female/Custom; do not add another download-wrapper folder. category is male/female/custom respectively; default-pool category must match gender. Each profiles entry needs a stable unique id (1–128 characters, no outer spaces), label, speaker_metadata.gender (male/female), category, reference_file, reference_sha256 (the real 64-digit SHA-256), prompt_lang and prompt_text. Prefer English labels plus a permanent style_target code, e.g. My Voice · AF-C100. Paths are relative to the pack and cannot escape it or use absolute drive paths. Optional emotion_variants keys are neutral/happy/angry/sad; each has its own path, hash, language and exact transcript. Limits: 2MiB per manifest, 128 manifests / 8MiB metadata / 512 voices overall. See docs/tts/manifest.example.json on GitHub; replace its placeholder hashes before use.
L guide 7 - Language and emotion

Speech output language accepts Chinese, Cantonese, English or Japanese, including their Chinese names. Blank/auto follows the reply. All four providers share it: matching text is kept; otherwise postprocessing privately translates speech without changing subtitles or history. Typing the Chinese word for Japanese selects a language code, not spoken content. Failed or missing translation stays text-only. Local tone uses the existing postprocessed MOOD, not gameplay action tags: JOY/DELIGHTED maps to happy, ANNOYED to angry, otherwise neutral; sad is available for manual audition. Keep one stable ID per character and put emotional references in emotion_variants; do not split Sparkle into four characters. Missing tones use the base reference. An angry reference helps but does not guarantee acting quality. Invented cute/flirty categories are not supported by the current automatic tag mapping.
L guide 8 - Troubleshooting and updates

No audio: check speech enabled, selected provider, runtime ready state, primary target, encyclopedia voice, combat restrictions and valid postprocessed translation when a language is forced. Bad reference paths/hashes, duplicate IDs or missing model files are rejected; AF does not silently switch to a paid API. Refresh or restart after adding packs. Re-extract an incomplete package; never replace it while running. If language selection reports an old runtime, update the matching L package instead of editing runtime.json to bypass verification. Errors: Logs/TTS; temporary cache: Cache/TTS. Report the error, AF/package version, GPU and reproduction steps after redacting API keys, tokens and private dialogue. Merge only the intended add-on; retain custom voices, character IDs, settings and other mods. Use trusted executable packages. The supplied share link does not establish redistribution rights for every recording. U requires a separate hardware and compatibility guide when released.
